scientific_integrity: Exact symbolic proof and replayed verifier; supporting finite enumeration is not substituted for proof. Independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: Classification is of marked parameters in characteristic five, not coarse isomorphism classes, and determines p-rank/a-number rather than full Newton polygons. The elliptic quotient construction is prior work, and historical priority cannot be certified exhaustively.
title: The characteristic-five Hasse divisor of the reciprocal genus-three Howe family
